system.description:
This spell allows the druid to create one special weather condition in the surrounding area (within a 240 yard radius). The caster may select the weather condition. The spell only works outdoors, and the weather will affect all creatures in the area (including the caster). The effects last as long as the caster concentrates, without moving; if the caster is being moved (for example, aboard a ship), the effect moves also. The spell's effects vary, but the following results are typical:

Rain causes a -2 penalty to attack rolls for all missile fire. After three turns, the ground becomes muddy, reducing movement to half the normal rate.

Snow reduces visibility (the distance a creature can see) to 20' and movement to half the normal rate. Rivers and streams may freeze over. Mud remains after the snow thaws, applying the same movement penalty.

Fog reduces visibility to 20' and movement to half the normal rate. Those within the fog might become lost, moving in the wrong direction.

Clear cancels bad weather (rain, snow, fog) but not secondary effects (such as mud).

Intense Heat reduces movement to half the normal rate. Excess water (from rain, snow, mud transmuted from rock, etc.) dries up.

High Winds prevent missile fire or flying. Movement is reduced to half normal. At sea, ships sailing with the wind move 50% faster. In the desert, high winds create a sandstorm, resulting in half normal movement and 20' visibility.

Tornado creates a whirlwind under the druid's control, attacking and moving as if it was a 12 HD air elemental. At sea, treat the tornado as a storm or gale.
